newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw puts off bond issue decision to 1998.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw puts off bond issue decision to 1998.

text.p: Warsaw may consider issuing a municipal bond in 1998 but does not plan any bond issues next year, Marcin Swiecicki, mayor of the Polish capital, said late on Thursday.
"There will be no municipal bond issue of Warsaw in 1997, but it is yet to be seen if we will carry out preparations for such an issue for the municipality in 1998," he told a news conference.
Earlier this year the city has signalled it was considering a $100 million eurobond to finance the construction of a new bridge. @
Swiecicki however told reporters the city would face the biggest expenditures for the construction in 1998 and then it would decide whether it needed a bond issue to finance the construction.
